description: Calculate fabric requirements for a quilting project including area calculations, shrinkage factors, yardage conversion with fabric width constraints, additional purchases needed, and total costs. Tests multi-step formulas, unit conversion, and constraint-based calculations.

natural_language.prompt: Complete the fabric calculator spreadsheet by adding formulas to calculate total fabric requirements, accounting for shrinkage, fabric width constraints, and costs. Determine how much additional fabric needs to be purchased.
